knowledge_point.title: Finding the Rank or Nullity of a Matrix Using the Rank-Nullity Theorem

question.:question/worked-solution:
According to the rank-nullity theorem, if $A$ is a matrix with $n$ columns, then 

$$
\text{rank}(A)+\text{nullity}(A)=n.
$$

For the given matrix, we have $n=12.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(A)+\text{nullity}(A) & =n \\ \text{rank}(A)+7 & =12 \\ \text{rank}(A) & =12-7 \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
